newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SHK Prop puts more E.Point flats on offer.
newsitem.headline: SHK Prop puts more E.Point flats on offer.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd said it would add another 152 units on top of 304 already on offer in its latest sale of flats in its East Point City residential development in Tseung Kwan O in Hong Kong's New Territories.
A company spokeswoman said on Tuesday the additional units would be offered at about HK$4,914 per square foot, up three percent from the initial offer price of HK$4,771 a square foot.
She said a total 5,850 potential buyers have registered to buy the units on the first day of registration on Monday.
The registration will close on Wednesday. The units, which range from 588 to 796 square feet, will go on sale on Saturday.
Shares of Sun Hung Kai Properties fell HK$1.00 to HK$94.75 in late morning.
